bible.title: Lagoon Sanctuary
bible.intent:
A tranquil rainforest cenote sanctuary framed around open turquoise water, a warm sunlit carved limestone doorway, a continuous curved stone viaduct with a brazier alcove, layered tropical foliage, schooling fish, circling swallows, and a tall twin-ribbon waterfall on the right.

Original scene and assets by Gemini 4 Neon (XHigh) in Antigravity.
bible.rules: Keep water native to Holodeck (lagoon ocean + native waterfalls). Keep arrival in cool shade with clear sightlines across the turquoise water to the sunlit doorway. Keep the arrival stairs, waterside dock, curved viaduct, sanctuary colonnade, and grand staircase continuously walkable and swimmable in both directions.
